steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Do it! Whack him!

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah! Swipe him from the right!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: That's right! Just like that! Hell yeah! Beat up this outsider moron!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Good one! Show this outsider the true strength of the Tiacauh Warriors!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Whoa, that's ruthless... Are they sworn enemies or something?

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Huh? Enemies? Who cares? We'll find out once they're done!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Exactly. It's just a fight! What's the big deal?

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Eh, speaking of, I've never seen you around. You new here?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Right, I'm a merchant doing some trading here and there. Just got here today.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: I heard there are quite a few tribes here, and figured I could make some money...

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Oh! A merchant! That means you're... uh... you sell stuff, right? Good! We welcome people who sell stuff here!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: But slow down a little. Whatever you've got, it can wait till after the show!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: But this...

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Eh, look! Got him! Beautiful!

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Tiacauh warriors always win!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: This how you guys treat all your guests?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hah, don't make me laugh.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You're the one who started it, and you want to be treated like a guest?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I already told you. I really didn't see you.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: The transport's door's a bit too tall. I thought you'd gotten on already.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'll swap the door out for a transparent one later.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Cut the crap. Let's go!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'm my tribe's strongest warrior... and we'll find out right now which of us is stronger.

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Do it, shorty! Show me the vigor you had when you wiped the floor with us!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: That's right, shorty! Jump up and use that super quick punch of yours to beat him up!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Maybe you want to take care of them first?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...That's none of your business!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hiss...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You're unarmed, but I have a weapon.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You can't win.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'll say this now. I'm not letting go of my weapon.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Have it your way.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But you don't get to decide who's going to win! You'll have to take it up with my fists!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: What a savage...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It's been so long since you left this place, but you haven't learned a thing other than the common tongue.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But I can see that... a place like this...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...suits a headstrong prick like you just fine.

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Hey, sounds like he's complimenting us!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: That's right! Only here in Acahualla can a warrior be born this tiny... but with such big fists!

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Huh? He's complimenting us? T-Then... are we still doing this?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: *cough*... I don't think that's a compliment...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You barbarians...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hmph... say all you want.
The Tiacauh warrior's tone has a hint of stiffness. Her eyes sweep the crowd in front of her.
She pauses momentarily as her gaze lands on a certain person.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'll remember this. I'm going to come settle the score with you later!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: If you outsiders are going to look down on us Tiacauh warriors, then maybe you should get out of Acahualla!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Yeah, that's the idea.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: If it wasn't for you barbarians not having even the tools to fix up a car... Uhh...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: (We wouldn't be wasting our time here!)

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...We wouldn't be wasting our time here.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Well, who knew your metal junk would break down during the trip?!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hey, you over there.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Stop looking around. I'm talking to you!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: M-Me?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Right, you. You said you're a trader, right?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Uh, yes. Yes, I am.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You've got anything that can patch up wounds? Give me some of that. The kind that works extra fast.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Is there something you want? I'll trade you for it.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Um... You need to pay for it.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What a pain... The last trader we had was okay with trading for things. How come we can't do that?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Maybe because you threatened the last guy with your fists?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Stay out of this!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Are you sure we can't trade? I have lots of good stuff. If you're okay with it, I can bring you to my place and trade you something there. That's the hottest place in all of Acahualla!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: If you indeed have something good to offer, then of course we can barter.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: That actually worked?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Well, this is business. Naturally, we need to be flexible. Haha.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: So, do we leave now to this... Aac... Acah...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Acahualla.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Right, Acahualla. The hottest place in Acahualla. I need to take a good look at this place. Perhaps I will be able to make a few deals there.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Haha, I'm sure you will!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Follow me!

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: What, now? Are they seriously gonna stop, just like that?

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Where are they going? No one goes that way normally. What are they doing that way? Hunting?

steps.name: Excited Archosauria
steps.text: Who knows... Eh, if there's no fight, let's get going. Let's see if that redhead outsider finished putting together that 'Forest Mk. VII' yet!

steps.name: Rowdy Archosauria
steps.text: Let's go! Inam's not around for the next couple of days. I want to take that giant thing we got apart to see what's inside!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: *pant*...*pant*....

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: A-Are we there yet?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Almost.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Stay close. There are lots of wild beasts around here. I can't guarantee your safety if you get lost.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Huh? Didn't you say we were going to the hottest place in town? How come there are beasts?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What's so weird about it? We're Tiacauh warriors. Of course we live in places where there are beasts.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: It's only when you can head into the rainforest and beat the most ferocious beasts on your own that you have proven yourself as a warrior!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Well, if that isn't amazing...

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: You were fighting that Feline man earlier without any weapons. Do all the warriors here fight like that?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: More or less. Some use spears since that's easier to fight beasts with, but I don't need them.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: All I need are my fists!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Haha, with how amazing you are, I'd say you really don't need anything else.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Right, I heard what the Feline was saying too. Something about a broken down transport?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: So you came back here with them, from the outside?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...You caught even that?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Eh, well... I just happened to overhear it.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Also, your common tongue is superb. Where did you learn to speak it? Outside Sargon?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: If you heard it, you heard it. What are you so tense for?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: A while back, a bunch of outsiders came here and told us they could take us outside to make some big bucks.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Oh, I see! And you followed them?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hell no! Do I look like I'm that bored?

spans.text: Hell no! Do I look like I'm

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I only went with them because they had a lot of tough fighters with them!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But in the end, they kept assigning me to protect some worthless loser who always stayed inside some metal box. No way I'm doing that! Outsiders are so weird. They're all a bunch of wusses, but they keep calling the shots.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: That's why I didn't even ask for any money and came right back.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Normally, those stupid lumps would've been long gone, but they're dawdling around because they keep saying their metal box has broken down.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Who knows how to fix those metal boxes anyway?! And there are all those weird metal thingies. I've never even seen those things!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: I mean, it's not like you guys would have any repair equipment...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What did you just say?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: *cough*... I mean... repairing transports is no cake walk.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Have the Acahualla warriors ever considered acquiring some tools for convenience?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Such as?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Such as, uh, that Feline's transport... or some kind of robot that could automatically help you with your tasks.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What would I do with those? I'm willing to bet those gaudy metal trinkets wouldn't last a single punch of mine.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Well, that's weird.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What's weird?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: To tell you the truth, I came to Acahualla to try my luck at business because I heard rumors about this place.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: But... I guess there's probably not many opportunities for that.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Huh? What do they say about us outside?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Is it how prestigious the Tiacauh warriors—

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Uh, that's got nothing to do with it.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Tch.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: I heard the tribes here are large and prosperous, that they've mastered quite a lot of robotics technologies, and they've even started trading with the outside.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: From the looks of it, they were nothing more than rumors.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: But it's too soon to jump to conclusions. As a merchant, you have to be patient and attentive. I'd still like to have a look around.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Maybe I'll run into a big tribe like from the rumors!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...What's that supposed to mean? Are you saying I'm lying?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Where's this coming from?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: —Wait, don't move!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hide behind me.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hurry! Stop dawdling!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: —A big one's coming.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Alright, we're safe. Come out.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: You actually managed to beat that huge pack of beasts all by yourself...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: That's nothing. Didn't I tell you? You'll only have proven yourself as a warrior if you can beat the most ferocious beasts on your own!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: This pack's huge, otherwise I would've had an easier time.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: No need to thank me. I was the one who brought you into the rainforest.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: ...Didn't you say you weren't going to guarantee my safety?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Fine, let's get your wound taken care of. Give me a moment. Let me look for some medicine and bandages.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Here, they're yours to keep. We'll call this your payment for protecting me earlier.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Oh! You sure about that?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: I'm sure. Take them.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: Eh, this really isn't quite like what they said outside.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: In hindsight, I guess I shouldn't have trusted those rumors.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Why shouldn't you have trusted those rumors?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: What? Do you mean...?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Our tribe's big and prosperous! There's no doubt about that!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: We can have up to forty or fifty people going out on a hunt at once!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Watch out! Why are you losing your footing all of a sudden?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: I-It's nothing. I walked a bit too much, and my legs are getting sore... Are we there yet?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: What's the rush? We're getting close. It's just up ahead.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I guarantee it'll open your eyes.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: You're back. How was it?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader
steps.text: ...Worthless.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: What happened to your face?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: Eh, don't get me started. I ran into a bunch of barbarians who've got nothing but muscles growing in their brains. They said I had to fight their warriors to go inside the village, then they immediately welcomed me with a punch in the face.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: The village was small and rundown. They hardly have any people there, and they haven't even seen transport repair tools before. What a waste of time!

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: Did you find anything on your end?

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: Nothing. I took a stroll in the other direction and found a redhead Vulpo fixing his transport. He said he was going to take me on a ride once it was fixed.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: I followed him around a little, and there were only some rundown houses.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: Though it kind of felt like he didn't want me poking around too much. Something didn't feel right about that.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: If you ask me, I think there's nothing to the rumors.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: You sure? You remember what the Padishah ordered us to do, right?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: Of course, but the results couldn't be more clear.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: At the very least, we've found no developing power here, and there's nothing we can gain from this place either. The Messenger stationed here wasn't lying.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: But according to the gossip...

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: I just think something doesn't add up about all this.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: You said it yourself. It's just gossip.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: The Messenger here... Our intel calls her Inam. She liked to trade and barter to begin with, so I'm not surprised the rumors got blown out of proportion.

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: Besides...

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: If the lords ameer take control of the territory here and it doesn't meet their expectations, having painted a rosy picture is only going to get us in trouble.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: ...Fair enough.

steps.name: Calm Woman
steps.text: You're right. They're a bunch of barbarians who do nothing but compare who's got the bigger fists. How could they possibly have fooled the two of us?

steps.name: Swept-Up Trader?
steps.text: Let's go back to the city and let the Padishah know.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: All taken care of?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: How were things on your end?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: We hid all the machines and metal choppers in a cave nearby. Nobody saw us.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: And we reminded everyone in the tribe not to talk about machinery in front of any outsiders.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Good work. Now we just need to wait till Inam's back.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: She left a letter and disappeared without a trace. Tch.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Right, that wound on your face...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'm fine.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Sorry, you can punch me back at the training grounds next time.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Really, don't worry about it.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Chiave probably would've been better at putting up that show, though.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: We didn't have a choice, since there was more than one of them. I asked Chiave to take care of the other person.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Actually, we could've gotten through this without that fight, but...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: But?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I couldn't help myself.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: I'll bash your face in at the training grounds next time.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Haha, just kidding.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But now those guys definitely consider us a bunch of barbarians who only think about fighting.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I took that guy to an old, abandoned settlement that's only used as a rest stop by warriors traveling outside the tribe, and he suspected nothing.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You can't say that for sure.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: It's fine as long as he can't be sure of anything either.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: As long as they don't get to the bottom of it, they won't report anything to their higher ups.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: —That's what the Doctor said.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: They're just lackeys. They're bound to avoid the riskier option.
That's right! Besides! With me on the job, nothing can possibly go wrong!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Man, that was exhausting. You know how much work it is to take apart a transport and then put it right back together?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Sorry, but that's the only excuse I could come up with.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: If you need me to pay for it...

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: No need! It's a piece of cake! We used to do this stuff all the time back when we were running cons... I mean, when we ran our old business. Don't believe me, ask Broca!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Wait... Hahahahaha! Broca, your face! Hahahahaha! That's hilarious!

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...Shut up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hahahahahahaha!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Ahem. Okay, back on topic.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Now that they're gone, we should be able to keep the status quo for a while longer. Inam, Zumama, and Gavial are all away. We'll have to settle for this.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Those guys won't give up that easily.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I guess that's true. If this was going to be that simple, Inam wouldn't have asked me to hold the fort.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Yeah... I'll have my tribesmen keep an eye out around the rainforest. If any of them come back, we'll deal with it somehow.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Whoa.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Man, I didn't expect the boss, that Inam, to trust you so much!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I only ever see you follow Blaze around. You don't even talk to the other operators from here all that much. I really didn't think you'd come all the way back like they did the moment you got that letter.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: It's true. I don't keep in contact with my tribe much.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Thankfully, I was in Columbia not too long ago. Inam gave me a call and asked me to bring a bunch of discarded metal choppers.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I'm not really too sure why she trusted me with this...

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You brought all those here?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: You have an eye for them. They can be put to good use once they're fixed up.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Why wouldn't she trust you? She saw how much you've grown. It's a good thing!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: I followed you guys here thinking I could help come up with ideas when push came to shove, but looks like you didn't need me at all.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You're always fighting Broca, so I thought you were the kind of girl who rushes right up to your opponents to beat them up.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I did kind of do that, too.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Never mind.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Acahualla's changed a lot, and the tribe has all these funny looking... machines. I really have no idea how they learned to put them together.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I thought Zumama's stuff was weird enough, but at least those things were shaped normal.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: The ones they made are pretty interesting, if you ask me.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: As long as it's practical.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: That's true. At the very least, life's gotten much better with these machines.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Really? If you guys came up with a machine that planted crops and hunted on its own, your Tiacauh warrior fists wouldn't mean anything for much longer.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: You seriously don't care even a little?

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Hey, Chiave!

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Eh, I'm just curious!

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I lost the right to determine my tribe's direction the moment I left my tribesmen behind.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: If the Tiacauhs chose this, then there's no problem. I don't understand what these machines are all about, but I trust the people here.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Fair enough.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Besides, I've thought about things while I was on Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...If everything could be solved by beating up your enemies, I wouldn't have so much to worry about.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: There was this time when... uh... I accompanied the Doctor as a bodyguard to a business meeting with a company, and they really tried to boss us around right from the start.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: It happens.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: I couldn't help myself, so I beat them all up.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: ...It happens.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Ahh... Yeah, that can be a pain in the ass to deal with.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: How come the Doctor didn't stop you?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Of course they did, so I beat them up while the Doctor was asleep.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Hey, hold on. I think I heard about this.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: So you were the one who wanted to give the Doctor more rest and stood guard outside the door, and ended up beating up all the guys who came looking for trouble?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Don't remind me...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: The deal almost fell through because of that, but we managed to save it at the expense of the Doctor's sanity.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: ...Anyway, I gave everyone lots of trouble that time.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Good thing the Doctor was there. They didn't give you a hard time, right?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Not at all. Actually, after we got back to Rhodes Island, they told me that fists really do mean everything.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: But our fists have to be big enough for that to work... and we don't always have what it takes yet, so we have to come up with other ways to solve our problems.

steps.name: Broca
steps.text: Fair point.

steps.name: Chiave
steps.text: M-Makes sense...

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Did you hear something just now?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Phew, finally.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Stop musing. We need to get to work.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Hm? How come there are all these machines here?

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Is that...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Hey, Kemar, good to see you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Judging by the look on your face, I'm guessing nothing bad happened.

steps.name: Flint
steps.text: Everything turned out okay in the end, I guess...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Good. Then I suppose you chased them all away? I knew you were the right one for the job.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I have plenty of other things I need your help with, but for now...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I need all of you to help us clear some space for a village. Acahualla is going to see a large crowd of visitors from the underground soon.
